Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished ORIGINAL art-direction concept of a LANDSCAPE ANDROID RACING GAME called VELOCITYVERSE. Wide 20:9 horizontal composition, edge-to-edge screen, NO phone bezel, NO browser, NO website header, NO laptop, NO real brand logos. This is a game interface over a lavish photorealistic 3D world, not a web dashboard or advertising poster. Reference aesthetic only: premium Asphalt garage car framing, NFS industrial racing culture, Cyberpunk cinematic nighttime density and GTA tropical city environmental detail, but original buildings, vehicles, layout and brand. Shared design system NEON COAST: midnight navy #080F1B translucent charcoal panels, warm ivory typography in a bold modern condensed grotesk, acid lime #DCFF52 primary actions, thin pale cyan secondary highlights, atmospheric plum/magenta light used sparingly. Very realistic painted metal, carbon fiber, machined wheels, imperfect wet concrete, dense inhabited architecture with balconies, glazing, air conditioners, cables, planted terraces. Cinematic selective illumination with restrained bloom, deep clean blacks, sharp readable interface. Generous Android touch targets, safe space at screen edges, visually sparse interface, no paragraphs, no tiny scattered labels, no charts or endless card grids. A compact top-left VELOCITYVERSE wordmark and small player chip SID / LV 24, small top-right credits 12,500 and settings icon. Bottom navigation is a slim substantial 5-item rail HOME / STORY / GARAGE / WORLD / CREW; large icons above short labels, active item acid lime. Stunning believable game art with intentional composition, real negative space for interface, not random cyberpunk visual clutter.
SCREEN 1: the home garage. Full-screen cinematic view of an original beautiful LOW SILVER ENCLOSED GT RACE CAR with graphite roof, sculpted wheel arches, exposed carbon front splitter, warm amber running lights and fine cyan side details. Car large, THREE-QUARTER FRONT VIEW, centered slightly right, wheels visibly round, accurate perspective, extraordinary craftsmanship. It sits in a sheltered waterfront race hangar opening onto a rainy neon harbor megacity at blue hour. Distant elevated train, cranes, rooftop gardens, tall glass towers, street shops, a few small distant crew silhouettes give scale. The beautiful car and world occupy 70 percent. On LEFT, a compact typographic mission title OPENLINE / CHAPTER 03 with headline OWN THE NIGHT, a short subtitle Lumen Harbor · Next story event, and one generous acid-lime CONTINUE STORY button with arrow. Below it two small secondary actions QUICK RACE and FREE DRIVE. On right near car, a small understated floating label VANTA GT / STREET SPEC. At bottom right above nav a compact next-objective strip NERI'S CHALLENGE / BEACON RUSH. HOME nav active. Design feels like a high-end real Android game home screen, dramatic rather than busy. Do not put labels over car windscreen or bright highlights.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a BEAUTIFUL POLISHED GAME UI MOTION STORYBOARD presentation board for the original Android racing game VELOCITYVERSE, wide landscape high resolution. Six equal landscape mini-screens arranged in a meticulous 3-column 2-row grid, small clear caption strip under each panel. This is a motion-design reference sheet, not a phone photograph, no browser. Every panel depicts the SAME expensive photorealistic silver original enclosed GT coupe with graphite roof in the SAME midnight navy waterfront race hangar with selective cyan/magenta environmental illumination, acid-lime buttons and ivory condensed type. Each miniature is a real sophisticated mobile game UI with sparse touch controls, car dominant. Cohesive richly detailed cinematic architecture, reflections and atmospheric depth. Accurate car perspectives, no trademarks from real automakers. Grid has deep navy gutters and a quiet top heading VELOCITYVERSE / MOTION LANGUAGE. The six panels communicate a SEQUENTIAL TRANSITION visually with fine thin arrows and ghosted position trails outside main car silhouettes, don't make random car collages. Panel1 home car emerging from shadow, title HOME REVEAL / 650 ms. Panel2 closeup CONTINUE STORY button slightly depressed with one small lime ripple, title TOUCH RESPONSE / 90 ms. Panel3 same car angled as a paint swatch changes silver to teal with a narrow color sweep, title GARAGE SWITCH / 350 ms. Panel4 physical-looking illuminated miniature coastal city map, selected lime route drawing along roads, title ROUTE REVEAL / 400 ms. Panel5 samecar headlights powering on as garage shutters open onto race circuit, title RACE LAUNCH / 700 ms. Panel6 restrained race-results overlay FINISH / PERSONAL BEST with three small earned-star lights and large CONTINUE button, silver car seenfront3quarter against lights, title REWARD REVEAL / 650 ms. All captions clean and concise. This is an explanatory storyboard of intended animation, not actual video footage. Professional motion art direction, highly finished AAA game mood adapted for a small Android touchscreen. Avoid illegible dense text and noisy all-over glow.
